description: This file contains shared utility functions for rate limiter hooks, specifically for converting priority reservation values to percentages, supporting multiple formats including plain numbers and dictionaries with specified types (percent, rpm, tpm).

classes.name: ModelGroupInfo
classes.description: Model configuration containing rpm/tpm limits, imported from litellm.types.router.

classes.name: PriorityReservationDict
classes.description: Type alias or class representing reservation dictionary, imported from litellm.types.utils.

methods.name: float convert_priority_to_percent( value: Union[float, PriorityReservationDict], model_info: Optional[ModelGroupInfo] )
methods.description: Converts a priority reservation value to a percentage (0.0-1.0), supporting different input formats including float, int, and dict with type/value keys, depending on the model info provided.
